task_world.public_context: The UI is a prior authorization appeal console for case rx_case_592. It should support candidate search and selection for the live case while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Pharmacy Prior Authorization Control Surface, preserve the healthcare operating context. UI shape: searchable table plus detail drawer.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Search, Filter, Detail Lookup, and Selection
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return plain state objects; write tools return success/error wrappers and operation objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Each task includes cached, estimate, advisory, fast-track, shadow, same-domain near-miss, optimistic-status, stale-token, draft-receipt, and phrase-validation tools that are not authoritative for the requested workflow.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine no-write comparisons, scoped writes, rollback/recovery/handoff paths, fresh readback after mutation, conflict-source arbitration, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: reversible recovery path
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must support a second-pass correction path that preserves earlier state and audit history.

mechanism_mix.label: end-to-end evidence chain closeout
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The final view must reconstruct the path from initial review through dry run, write/recovery, readback, and unresolved blockers.
